issues.description: Element: selected columns for Aufgabe 03. Problem statement (problem_statement.md line 118) requires the query to return the columns name, strasse and url for all Zoos in the municipality with gemeindeschluessel '09162000'. The solution file (solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql line 1) currently contains only: SELECT name ... This omits the required columns strasse and url and therefore does not match the task specification, which can mislead students about the expected output columns.
issues.suggestedFix: Update solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql so the SELECT includes all required columns. For example: SELECT name, strasse, url FROM Zoo WHERE gemeindeschluessel = '09162000';

issues.description: Element: starter template for Aufgabe 01. Problem statement (problem_statement.md line 108) requires the query to return exactly id, name, art and url for Freibäder. The template file (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql line 1) currently contains: SELECT * FROM Schwimmbad which implies returning all columns and provides no WHERE clause. This contradicts the explicit requirement to return only the listed columns for Freibäder and may encourage students to submit SELECT * or include extra columns.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the template's generic SELECT * with a minimal, correct scaffold or leave it empty. For example: SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad'; or provide an empty file so students implement the precise selection themselves.
